0.why: TuringVoltsExpander.cpp:47-53 sums params[i]*0.2 over the set bits, clamps the total to 0 and 10 and calls setVoltage

comment: Each knob is configured 0 to 10V and its tooltip reads in those terms, but TuringVoltsExpander.cpp:49 multiplies it by 0.2 before adding it in, so one knob alone can contribute at most 2V and the full 10V needs all five knobs up and all five bits high. The module walks left through the chain looking for a TuringMaschine, so several of these can be chained; the sequencer's own loop at TuringMaschine.cpp:246-261 writes the top five bits to every one it finds to its right. The panel carries no lettering on any control.
